purpose: Define stable identity rules for every machine-significant node so recursive readers resolve semantics by identity rather than path, label or document position.

topics.name: Canonical Node Identity
topics.purpose: Define stable identity rules for every machine-significant node so recursive readers resolve semantics by identity rather than path, label or document position.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant canonical node has an explicit stable identity appropriate to its node kind.
semantics.path_rule: Filesystem path is storage location, not semantic identity.
semantics.label_rule: Human-readable name/label is not sufficient identity.
semantics.move_rule: Moving a node/document does not change semantic identity.
semantics.reference_rule: Machine-significant cross-node references target canonical identities.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: path or display label is sole identity

references.purpose: Identified nodes are classified by Topics.

prose.summary: Define stable identity rules for every machine-significant node so recursive readers resolve semantics by identity rather than path, label or document position.
